note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 3768 Section 5.2.3 says "A VRRP router receiving a packet with the TTL not equal to 255 MUST discard the packet." TestDecodeGoldenV2 lost only the assertion on the removed MsgOnlyChecksum flag, which carried no RFC 3768 content, and TestNegativeReferenceBugs gained the FillChecksum mode argument and an rfc5798-compatible lookup in N1 alone; verifyReceived returns before any mode is read for version 2, so the VRRPv2 decode under judgement is unchanged. TestDecodeV2DiscardsTTLNot255 still accepts the VRRPv2 golden at TTL 255 and refuses TTL 0/1/64/254 with ErrTTL. Verdict unchanged.
